R setup retry contract

Package check  -> shared setup-r wrapper -> attempt 1 -> attempt 2 if needed -> terminal attempt 3
Pkgdown deploy -> shared setup-r wrapper -> attempt 1 -> attempt 2 if needed -> terminal attempt 3

Runner-controlled evidence:
failure -> success                    = workflow success
failure -> failure -> success         = workflow success
failure -> failure -> failure         = captured terminal failure

R version specification: 4.5 (unchanged)
Installer authority: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2 (unchanged)
Public package manager: enabled (unchanged)
Maximum setup attempts: 3
Scientific or package-runtime behavior: unchanged
